name: La Imperial Taqueria
notes: No restaurant-owned website found; listed as Taqueria Imperial / Taqueria La Imperial. FoodBoss embeds a server-rendered DoorDash-sourced menu (Next.js page data) for this address (1351 3rd Avenue, Chula Vista, CA 91911, matches work-list address); DoorDash record timestamp is 2020-02-25 so this is an old snapshot, flagged rather than hidden. Cross-checked against Allmenus (Grubhub-owned, independent of DoorDash), which lists the same address and the same prices on every overlapping item (Machaca Breakfast Burrito $5.99, Campechana Cali Burrito $7.49, Rolled Tacos $3.49/4.49/6.49/9.49, etc) with zero mismatches across 52 items - agreement across two independently-owned platforms is why this is reported as medium rather than blocked despite the age. Did not merge the two listings into one dish set (Allmenus also names a few soda flavors and two extra items DoorDash lists only generically); only the single FoodBoss/DoorDash source below is recorded to avoid combining non-overlapping listings. A same-address .shop domain (taquerialanuevaimperial.shop) 301-redirects to locallya.com, a barred directory farm, and was not used. Uber Eats store page returned a 572-byte JS shell with no server-rendered prices. Sections reached: Breakfast Burritos, Quesadillas, Tacos, Rolled Tacos, Burritos, Mulitas, Aguas, Combo Plate, Tortas, Carne Asada Nachos, Carne Asada Fries, Can Sodas, Sodas Mexicanas (13 sections, matches Allmenus section list plus Quesadillas/Nachos that Allmenus omitted).

name: Mauricio's Mexican Food
notes: No restaurant-owned website found. order.online (DoorDash white-label storefront, "Powered by DoorDash Commerce Platform") for 3200 Adams Ave, San Diego confirmed by page copy. The visible carousel HTML only renders a 25-30 item "Most Ordered/Featured" highlight sample, but the page also server-embeds the full per-category catalog as escaped GraphQL JSON (typename MenuPageItem) inside a Next.js flight payload; each item carries a base64 nextCursor decodable to a real categoryId, and the page separately embeds a MenuBookCategory list giving each category a name and an authoritative numItems count. Matched MenuPageItem entries against that count exactly for all 17 real categories (142 unique items after removing 10 duplicate encodings) - Burritos 20, Especiales 8, Quesadillas 3, Rolled Tacos 3, Drinks 5, Extras 14, Tortas 8, Tacos 7, Tostadas 8, Combination Plate 19, Seafood 17, Big Plate 1, Enchiladas 5, Chimichangas 5, Soups 4, Hamburgers 4, Sides 11 - so this is the complete category-by-category menu, not the sample. Excluded the separate "Most Ordered" (StorePageCarouselItem) highlight set entirely rather than merging it in, since its items duplicate ones already counted under their real category. Markup check across all 142 prices found no consistent divisor (1.04-1.3 all near-zero hit rate), so these read as DoorDash-catalog prices rather than a clean delivery surcharge. Categories reached: all 17 listed above (100% of numItems declared by the page itself). Other same-address listings found: mauricios1mexicanfood.shop (redirects toward a directory-farm-style site, not used), thaitomseattle.com (unrelated/mismatched domain naming, not used), zmenu.com and restaurantji.com (directory listings, not used since order.online already gave a complete first-party-adjacent source).

name: OB Bean Coffee Roasters
notes: Restaurant own site (obbeans.com) timed out on every attempt (curl exit 28, retried 3x over several minutes) - a sibling agent with a working connection should retry it directly, this is a temporary access problem, not evidence the site lacks a menu. Toast page (toasttab.com/local/order/sur-coffee-ob-beans-4879-newport-ave/...) loaded but its embedded __OO_STATE__ Apollo cache shows hasOnlineOrderingModule:false and contains no Menu-typed data at all - Toast ordering is not active for this location, so no prices are available there. Used Allmenus (tier 5) address-matched to 4879 Newport Ave/Newport Avenue, San Diego 92107; cross-checked against SinglePlatform (restaurant-submitted, tier 4, independent of Grubhub/Allmenus), which lists the same address, phone 619-738-8151, and the same 10 of these 14 items at identical prices (Filter Coffee $2.50 through Chai Latte $4.50) - agreement across two independently-owned sources is why this is reported rather than blocked, but tier-5 confidence is capped at low per house rules regardless of that agreement. SinglePlatform did not carry the 4 items only on Allmenus (Matcha Latte, Tea, El Salvador, Guatemala) - not merging the two lists, reporting Allmenus as-is since it is the fuller single source, not a combination. Every item on both sources is a drink; this business also mentions pastries in its own social bio, but no pastry/food item is priced on any of the sources checked (Allmenus, SinglePlatform, joe.coffee, Toast), so no food dishes are recorded - this reads as a small, drinks-only priced menu rather than a partial capture of a larger one. Only section found: "Bar Menu" (Allmenus/SinglePlatform template label, not necessarily the shop's own wording).

name: Greek Style Chicken
notes: No restaurant-owned website found. Used DoorDash marketplace page (server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD), address confirmed as 904 South Main Avenue, Fallbrook, matching the work-list address exactly. Markup check across all 91 raw items showed no consistent divisor (1.04-1.3 all low hit rate, max 4/91), so prices read as DoorDash catalog prices rather than a clean surcharge. 6 items in a "Most Ordered" highlight section duplicated items already listed under their real category at identical prices (cross-check within source, e.g. Gyro Pita $13.05 both places); those duplicates were dropped. 6 more items only ever appeared in "Most Ordered" with no dedicated category of their own in this source (SM/LG Fries, SM/LG Zucchini, Baklava, Soft Drink-LG) - kept under a section labeled "Sides, Drinks & Dessert" since DoorDash never gave them one. A number of Greek Combo item names are truncated in the source data itself (e.g. "#10 ,GREEK C", "# 9 ,  GREEK C") - recorded verbatim rather than guessed/completed, since the full name is not recoverable from this source. Sections reached: BURGERS, SANDWICHES, GREEK COMBOS, SALAD, Sides/Drinks/Dessert. Missing relative to what the business advertises: a dedicated Kabobs section and any additional dessert beyond Baklava were not found on DoorDash - Yelp and the restaurant's Instagram both reference kabobs/gyros as specialties but no priced kabob item appears on this source.
